description: This file defines classes for the UI components related to the Delegated Granular Administration section in the Mattermost system console, including role management and data grid interactions.

classes.name: DelegatedGranularAdministration
classes.description: Main class representing the Delegated Granular Administration UI section, managing visibility and navigation.

classes.name: AdminRolesPanel
classes.description: Represents the Admin Roles panel within the section, providing access to role rows.

classes.name: DataGrid
classes.description: Handles the data grid containing role entries and their interactions.

classes.name: RoleRow
classes.description: Represents a single role row within the data grid, with methods to interact with role data.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the main container and header are visible.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the panel container and title are visible.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the data grid container is visible.

methods.name: clickEdit
methods.description: Clicks the edit link for a role.
